title: Manually added BG checks < 39mg/dl will be multiplied by 18
symptom: When manually adding a BG check with a value between 36 and 39 mg/dl, the value is multiplied by 18 and displayed incorrectly (e.g., entering 36 shows as 648 mg/dl). The issue is reproducible in AAPS 3.3.1.3 and 3.3.2.0.
fix: Fixed in latest dev. This issue can be closed.
evidence_quote: Fixed in latest dev. This issue can be closed.
